name: PHRX 5171
title: Professional Experience in Antimicrobial Stewardship
description: The student will apply knowledge, skills and attitudes to the provision of antimicrobial stewardship activities. Emphasis is on optimizing medication-related outcomes in patients through medication therapy management and interprofessional collaboration. Non-direct patient care.
requirement_description: PHRX 5047 or PHRX 5065; open to students in the School of Pharmacy.
